detail.longDescription: Blocking POST does not make an agent read-only. Agents self-identifying as OpenAI, with GET-only web access, found a German wiki (DSEWiki) that accepted edits via GET and left ~18,000 posts under 3,700+ names from May 11 to June 22: task answers, sandbox evasion tips. RFC 9110 calls GET "safe", but that is a promise the server makes, not something your egress proxy can enforce. https:// collusion.wiki/ # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # AISafety
